data.one_liner: Check pub.dev for updates for your Dart CLI and print update information.
data.what_it_does: It checks pub.dev to see if a newer version of your Dart command-line tool is available. If an update exists, it prints notification details to the console.
use_when: You are building a Dart CLI tool and want to notify users of available updates
You want a simple API to check pub.dev version info directly in your main function
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI or mobile application instead of a CLI
You need complex offline-first caching for update checks
strengths: Simple and straightforward setup with minimal code
Tailored specifically for Dart CLI packages
weaknesses: Relies entirely on network requests to pub.dev during CLI startup
